callees.name: _required_string
callees.pre_condition: raw_value is the value to validate. field_name identifies the field for error messages. source is a provenance string.
callees.post_condition: Returns raw_value as a string when raw_value is a non-empty string. Raises an error with a message that includes field_name and source when raw_value is None, empty, or not a string.

callees.name: _string_list
callees.pre_condition: raw_value is expected to be an iterable of strings. field_name identifies the field for error messages. source is a provenance string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a tuple of strings derived from raw_value. When raw_value is an empty or non-list value, returns an empty tuple. When raw_value is a non-empty list of strings, returns those strings as a tuple. Raises an error with a message that includes field_name and source when any element of raw_value is not a string.
